'''Ordaj Besh''' was one of the seventeen [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Ordaj]] in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].<ref name="SB" /><ref name="GJ" /><ref name="EA" /> The system was a collection of barren worlds and whirling rocks, devoid of apparent wealth and marginally habitable only by the desperate.<ref name="EA" /> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Ordaj itself had no known [[City/Legends|settlements]]; however, Ordaj Besh possibly housed a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base.<ref name="GJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Ordaji was introduced in the first part of the article series ''[[Hoth: Under the Ice]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on [[Wizards.com]] in [[2003]].<ref name="SB" /> Later, the [[2004]] web supplement ''[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]'' named one of Ordaji's moons.<ref name="GJ" />
